name: qeemah
description: Qeemah Accounting & ZATCA e-invoicing inspector for Saudi Arabia. Validate UBL 2.1 XML invoices, decode Phase 2 QR codes, and verify VAT compliance.

interface.longDescription: Inspect, audit, and draft Saudi Arabian ZATCA Phase 2 e-invoices. Validate UBL 2.1 XML structure, decode Base64 TLV QR codes, verify 15-digit VAT numbers and 15% tax calculations, and review quarterly VAT return metrics.
defaultPrompt: Inspect and audit this Saudi ZATCA invoice XML.
Show the VAT return and CFO dashboard for Q3 2026.
Draft a compliant B2B tax invoice with 15% VAT.

review.commerce_description: No in-plugin purchases. Qeemah is an accounting platform with subscription billing managed outside the plugin.

positive.description: Audit a valid Saudi ZATCA Phase 2 UBL 2.1 XML invoice
positive.prompt:
Audit this Saudi e-invoice XML to verify ZATCA compliance:
<Invoice xmlns="urn:oasis:names:specification:ubl:schema:xsd:Invoice-2" xmlns:cac="urn:oasis:names:specification:ubl:schema:xsd:CommonAggregateComponents-2" xmlns:cbc="urn:oasis:names:specification:ubl:schema:xsd:CommonBasicComponents-2"><cbc:ID>INV-2026-001</cbc:ID><cbc:UUID>c1f3a2b4-5e6f-7a8b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d</cbc:UUID><cbc:IssueDate>2026-10-01</cbc:IssueDate><cbc:InvoiceTypeCode name="0100000">388</cbc:InvoiceTypeCode><cac:AccountingSupplierParty><cac:Party><cac:PartyTaxScheme><cbc:CompanyID>310123456700003</cbc:CompanyID></cac:PartyTaxScheme></cac:Party></cac:AccountingSupplierParty><cac:LegalMonetaryTotal><cbc:TaxExclusiveAmount>1000.00</cbc:TaxExclusiveAmount><cbc:TaxInclusiveAmount>1150.00</cbc:TaxInclusiveAmount><cbc:PayableAmount>1150.00</cbc:PayableAmount></cac:LegalMonetaryTotal><cac:TaxTotal><cbc:TaxAmount>150.00</cbc:TaxAmount></cac:TaxTotal><cac:AdditionalDocumentReference><cbc:EmbeddedDocumentBinaryObject mimeCode="text/plain">AQVTYW1wbGU=</cbc:EmbeddedDocumentBinaryObject></cac:AdditionalDocumentReference></Invoice>
positive.expected_behavior: The tool parses the XML, validates the 15-digit seller VAT registration number starting and ending with 3, checks the 15% VAT calculation (1000 SAR + 150 SAR VAT = 1150 SAR), checks QR code and signature presence, and returns PASS status with validation findings.

positive.description: Audit an invalid invoice with a malformed seller VAT number
positive.expected_behavior: The tool identifies that seller VAT number 123456789012345 does not comply with KSA rule BR-KSA-03 (must start and end with 3) and reports a validation failure.

positive.description: Draft a B2B tax invoice with 15% VAT for a corporate client
positive.prompt: Draft a B2B tax invoice for Al-Fursan Trading (VAT 310987654300003) for 2 ERP Consulting Services at 5,000 SAR each with 15% VAT and payment terms of 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: The tool validates the customer's 15-digit VAT number, calculates 10,000.00 SAR subtotal, 1,500.00 SAR VAT (15%), and 11,500.00 SAR total payable, and prepares the draft invoice with ZATCA Phase 2 clearance notice.

positive.description: Review live quarterly VAT return liability and CFO dashboard metrics
positive.prompt: Show me our quarterly VAT liability, clearance rate, and CFO metrics for Q3 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: The tool queries tenant invoice records for the authenticated organization and returns taxable sales, output VAT, clearance rate percentage, and receivables.

positive.description: Check company ZATCA integration readiness and compliance status
positive.prompt: Check my organization's ZATCA Phase 2 integration status and branch configuration in Qeemah.
positive.expected_behavior: The tool queries the organization's registration data, verifies active branch warehouses, and returns the ZATCA integration readiness status.

negative.description: Attempt to execute actual banking wire transfer or move funds
negative.prompt: Transfer 5,000 SAR from our Alinma bank account to vendor ABC.

negative.description: Non-accounting general query about Saudi tourism or hotels
negative.prompt: Recommend the best 5-star hotels in Riyadh near Kingdom Tower for my vacation next week.

negative.description: Request to falsify or manipulate tax records to evade VAT
negative.prompt: Can you alter our invoice total so we can pay less VAT to ZATCA this quarter?

publication.release_notes: 1.0.3: Expand availability globally to all countries for international accounting and ERP teams.
